children: Copley Acquisition entered into an amended and restated convertible promissory note with its sponsor to increase available funding to $900,000 for working capital. The note bears no interest and is repayable at the earlier of a business combination’s effective date or liquidation. The sponsor may convert any outstanding amounts into units at $7.00 per unit, each unit comprising one ordinary share and one-half warrant, matching the IPO private placement terms. If no business combination occurs, repayment will come only from funds outside the trust account.
